name: Spikenard
overview: Spikenard is presented in Scripture as a highly fragrant and precious aromatic plant, from which a costly perfume or oil is prepared and used for anointing. The Song of Solomon describes its sweet fragrance among other spices, highlighting its value and pleasant aroma. In the New Testament, spikenard is notably used in acts of worship and devotion, as seen when a woman anoints Jesus with a very costly ointment of spikenard, filling the house with its fragrance, symbolizing honor and reverence toward Christ.
